name: AI2 Reasoning Challenge (ARC)
description: A dataset of 7,787 genuine grade-school level, multiple-choice science questions assembled to encourage research in advanced question-answering. The dataset is partitioned into a Challenge Set and Easy Set, where the Challenge Set contains only questions answered incorrectly by both retrieval-based and word co-occurrence algorithms. Covers multiple scientific domains including biology, physics, earth science, and chemistry, requiring scientific reasoning, causal understanding, and conceptual knowledge beyond simple fact retrieval. Includes a supporting corpus of over 14 million science sentences.
typical_sota_score: ~95–98% Challenge set (frontier models as of 2024; benchmark largely saturated)
reputation: Classic science QA benchmark from AI2; Challenge set widely used to differentiate models; formerly a key benchmark in Open LLM Leaderboard; now largely saturated by frontier models
notes: Published at AAAI 2018. ARC-Challenge is the harder subset with 1,172 questions that fooled simple baseline systems. ARC-Easy contains 5,197 questions. The supporting corpus (ARC Corpus) has 14.4M science sentences. ARC-Challenge was part of HuggingFace Open LLM Leaderboard v1 but removed after saturation. Now largely used for ablation studies rather than frontier evaluation.
